verdict.rationale: ucp.dev presents UCP as an industry-governed open standard. It lists co-developers including Google, Etsy, Wayfair, Target, Walmart, Microsoft, Stripe and others, and says the specification and reference implementations are public on GitHub (confirmed by a probe of the versioned spec and GitHub org). Shopify docs also describe payment handlers like com.google.pay and a Universal Cart spanning merchants 'on or off Shopify'. However, the co-developer wall is a claim of participation, not evidence of shipped third-party implementations. All runtime probes hit only Shopify-operated endpoints, and the Universal Cart is still waitlisted. Missing for 10: concrete evidence of at least two non-Shopify parties running live UCP implementations, independent or hands-on corroboration of third-party adoption.
